name: Pariah
title: Daredevil #229
desc:
Ben is warned off of investigating a story about Murdock and the Kingpin. A wounded Matt is tended by Sister Maggie.

After Kingpin discovered that Daredevil is Matt Murdock and subsequently destroyed his life, Matt is suffering with depression while living in the streets with no home, no friends and no work anymore. Ben Urich is investigating what happened to him but encounters obstacles. Matt is stabbed in the streets and keeps walking while bleeding. Kingpin's goons try to kill Karen Page because she was the one who sold Matt's identity, and Kingpin wants everyone who knows the secret dead. Eventually Matt falls down inside his father's old boxing academy and a nun helps him. Kingpin learns that Matt is still alive.
